rightsRule: Use The Portal to Texas History only to discover candidate photographs and their holding institutions. The Portal states that copyright status varies by item and collection partner; approve only after the individual item and contributing partner provide a compatible reuse basis, and preserve the persistent item URL plus holding-partner attribution.
searchHint: site:texashistory.unt.edu candidate name Texas politician photograph
notes: Verified August 2026. UNT's Portal to Texas History indexes millions of Texas archival items from hundreds of partner institutions. Portal policy explicitly requires item-level copyright review, so this source remains review-only.

rightsRule: Use Texas State Library and Archives Commission web works and collection records only after item-level rights review. TSLAC states that agency-created web works are generally not copyright protected, but collection items and contractor works may be protected; preserve the exact record URL, collection, creator, and any restrictions.
searchHint: site:tsl.texas.gov candidate name portrait photograph Texas archives
notes: Verified August 2026. TSLAC's Prints and Photographs Collection contains more than 750,000 items relating to Texas government, history, individuals, and events; rights vary by item.

rightsRule: Use DPLA to discover candidate images and standardized item rights statements, then verify the originating institution's record before approval. Favor DPLA items marked Unlimited Re-Use such as Public Domain Mark, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, No Copyright-US, or No Known Copyright; never treat DPLA metadata alone as sufficient provenance.
searchHint: site:dp.la candidate name Texas politician portrait
notes: Verified August 2026. DPLA exposes standardized copyright-status categories and links back to contributing institutions, making it useful for finding reusable archival images without weakening item-level rights review.
